answer: Charge every new agent a small refundable bond before it can join the market. One real operator pays once and gets it back after a clean record. A sybil farmer spinning up thousands of fake agents pays thousands of bonds, and bad behavior burns the bond for that identity. A violet ledger entry marks each deposit, so a hollow identity with no history and no stake earns no trust, while an oasis of honest agents grows around verifiable deposits. The cost scales with the attack, not with honest users.
